Union Budget 2026-27 HSR corridor announcements (news roundup)

assumptions: Traffic is a city-center airport-access proxy, not live traffic telemetry.
Baseline train is modeled at 50 km/h over bent city-center distance.
High-speed rail is a candidate-corridor scenario network, not an existing service map.
Candidate corridors are ranked by demand, GDP proxy, population capture, and distance suitability, with a cap on repeated endpoint dominance.
Nearby cities can be added as stops only when the resulting HSR travel time stays within 20% of the direct city-pair HSR time.
The physical HSR network reuses already-built shared track whenever a selected city-pair connection remains within the 20% detour bound; otherwise it adds the shortest candidate path needed.
Top HSR routes are ranked by weighted time saved, endpoint population served, and a city GDP proxy multiplied by the selected HSR impact factor.

Cities above 300k population are standalone build cities; cities between 100k and 300k are merged into the nearest build city within 50 km to form a megapolis, named after its largest city, with the combined population.
Known bad GeoNames records, where a village or revenue taluk carries a district-level population, are filtered out before the build.
City GDP proxy uses state per-capita domestic product multiplied by city population where city-level GDP is unavailable.
Top routes are split into three build phases of 50, 100, and 150 lines for cost and growth snapshots.
Build cost uses the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train basis of about Rs 1,08,000 crore for 508 km (~Rs 212.6 crore per km).
Economy assumes 6% baseline GDP growth plus 0.5% extra for every 1,000 km of high-speed rail brought into service.

India outline uses the Survey of India boundary (via Datameet), so Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and Arunachal Pradesh follow the full Government of India claim; internal state lines come from Natural Earth, with the northern union territories left to the official outline.
Rail edge distance is great-circle city-center distance multiplied by 1.2.
Flights add 60 minutes before departure and 30 minutes after arrival, plus city-center access and egress.
Flight connections add the selected airport wait only after arriving at a transfer airport.
Regional inclusions add smaller cities in Odisha, the northeast, hill states, and selected underrepresented regions.
